🏦 The closure of Ueno Bank due to financial fraud has tied up the operating funds of numerous micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Paraguay, causing a significant drop in their business activity, Guillermina Imlach, vice president of the Paraguayan Federation of MSMEs, reported on Saturday, November 21. 📊 According to a survey of 94 companies in the sector conducted by the federation, 48% lost more than 60% of their sales in the last two weeks due to the freezing of funds used to pay salaries and purchase goods. ⚖️ The intervention initiated on November 3 by the Central Bank of Paraguay (BCP) at the bank (which reported 2.94 million customers) triggered a political crisis that led to the removal of Santiago Peña from the presidency, while the state-owned Financial Development Agency announced $7.8 million in loans to assist the sector.

NOTE: Contrary to reports, there are no missile launches identified from Khuzestan / Ahvaz at this time. Aircraft trails have been frequently misidentified as missile trails. @Middle_East_Spectator Ballistic missile launchers in Khuzestan, Ahvaz, and other sites in western Iran are not for Gulf state targets. They are for either Jordan or Iraqi Kurdistan. Missile launches in these areas are also frequently surface-to-air missile launches against American/Israeli reconnaissance UAVs.

A total of 40 people, including 25 minors, have been hospitalized following the leak of an unknown substance at a teacher training college in the western Slovak town of Modra, the TASR news agency reported. Among the 40 patients are 25 teenagers aged between 15 and 17. The substance has not been disclosed.
